instruction.text: Label the missing coordinates of the corners of this square.
Label the missing coordinates of the vertices of this isosceles triangle.

text.text: Remember that an isosceles triangle has two equal angles and two equal lengths. This means that the top point is halfway between the other two points on the x-axis.

atoms.a: If the triangle was translated 3 squares to the right, what would be the new coordinates of the top corner?
If the triangle was translated 1 square to the right and 2 squares up, what would be the new coordinates of the bottom left corner?
If the triangle was translated 1 square to the left and 4 squares down, what would be the new coordinates of the bottom right corner?
